title: Valencia and Real Betis face off in postponed La Liga match
seoTitle: Valencia vs Real Betis: Postponed La Liga Match
subtitle: The clash at Mestalla Stadium counts towards the first round of the Spanish league.
excerpt: Valencia and Real Betis take the field this Tuesday to play a postponed match from the opening round of La Liga 2026/27 at the Mestalla Stadium.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Valencia and Real Betis take the field this Tuesday at 4:00 PM Brasília time to play a postponed match from the first round of La Liga at the Mestalla Stadium. The clash pits two teams with contrasting paths in their most recent Spanish league matches against each other.

How Valencia and Real Betis head into the clash

Valencia are looking for their first win in the Spanish league after drawing 0-0 against Celta de Vigo at Mestalla. The team managed by Carlos Corberán struggled to convert possession into clear-cut chances in their previous match.

On the other hand, Real Betis kicked off their domestic campaign with a 1-0 victory over Real Sociedad, thanks to a goal from Rodrigo Riquelme. Manuel Pellegrini's side heads into the matchup having secured points and kept a clean sheet in the league so far.

The reason for the match postponement

Today's match is valid for the opening round of the competition. This fixture is part of a group of matches that were postponed as an adjustment made to accommodate players who participated in the final stages of the World Cup.

Head-to-head history

The history between the teams shows a strong balance in previous encounters. Across dozens of matches played, the stats show an equal number of wins for each side, alongside draws throughout the history of the rivalry.

Where to watch and live stream

Fans wishing to follow every detail of the clash between Valencia and Real Betis can watch the live broadcast on CazéTV, directly on YouTube, starting at the scheduled kickoff time.

With information from VEJA, NETVASCO, iG Esportes.
